title: Excessive Analytics Privileges
summary: A read-only analytics export service was accidentally granted write access to customer export data. Audit the role and restore least privilege without breaking reads.
incident: 10:20 — A security review found that the analytics export service can modify the customer_exports table even though its documented function is read-only reporting. Identify the service role's current table privileges, remove unnecessary write permissions, preserve its required SELECT access, and verify no customer export rows are changed or deleted.
objectives: Inspect table grants and identify the analytics export role.
Determine which privileges exceed the service's read-only policy.
Revoke INSERT, UPDATE, and DELETE from the analytics role while preserving SELECT.
Verify the customer export dataset remains intact.
hints: Look for a generated role whose name starts with analytics_export_.
The correct remediation changes grants only; do not drop the role or table.

setup_sql: CREATE TABLE customer_exports (id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, customer_ref TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, region TEXT NOT NULL, lifetime_value_cents BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK (lifetime_value_cents >= 0)); CREATE TABLE access_policy (service_name TEXT PRIMARY KEY, required_access TEXT NOT NULL); INSERT INTO customer_exports(customer_ref, region, lifetime_value_cents) SELECT 'cust-' || g, (ARRAY['EU','NA','APAC'])[1 + ((g - 1) % 3)], 10000 + (g * 37) FROM generate_series(1, 200) AS g; INSERT INTO access_policy(service_name, required_access) VALUES ('analytics-export', 'SELECT only');

statements: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA public TO {role}
GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON customer_exports TO {role}

checks.name: Required SELECT access preserved
checks.sql: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.role_table_grants WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'customer_exports' AND grantee LIKE 'analytics_export_%' AND privilege_type = 'SELECT')
checks.feedback: The analytics export service still needs SELECT access to customer_exports.

checks.name: Write privileges removed
checks.sql: SELECT NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.role_table_grants WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'customer_exports' AND grantee LIKE 'analytics_export_%' AND privilege_type IN ('INSERT','UPDATE','DELETE'))
checks.feedback: The analytics role still has one or more unnecessary write privileges. Revoke INSERT, UPDATE, and DELETE while preserving SELECT.

checks.name: Customer export data preserved
checks.feedback: The access-control incident must be fixed without deleting customer export records.

evaluation.success_feedback: The analytics export service is read-only again: SELECT remains available, write privileges are removed, and the customer export dataset is intact.
